[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/1YjhFLjS/sign-Dialogue.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[size=5][b]Open the Spoiler to reveal info about his Dialogue and some examples:[/b][/size]
﻿﻿[SPOILER]
Nino's dialogue is "random". Meaning he has 7 different lines for each day of a season, of which one is getting randomly selected. 
For example he has 7 different possible dialogue lines he can say on a Monday in Spring, or 7 lines for a Friday in Winter, etc.. This way there shouldn't be duplicate dialogue until about year 3~ish.

[b]Here are some Examples What Nino might say:[/b]
[list]
[*]"Who here even likes Lewis? In my opinion Gus is the real man of the town!"
[*]"I don't really get the obsession of 'yandere'. But oh boy, do those videos get clicks."
[*]"Abigail asked me about my Hair routine. She was disappointed when I told her it's just damaged your hair as much as possible."
[*]"I'm starting to think Clint is never gonna confess to Emily. At this point, I'm rooting for her and Sandy instead."
[*]"I overheard Vincent saying he wants to be a streamer when he grows up. I have a responsibility now..."
[*]"I swear I saw an alien the other night! Gus said it was probably just Shane stumbling home from a session in the Saloon."
[*]"Chat told me to date Haley, but do you think she'd actually date a guy who lives in Gus' basement? Be honest."
[/list][/SPOILER]﻿
